step1_analysis.description: A dual-phase-controlled dynamic latched amplifier designed for high-speed and low-power DRAMs. It senses small differential input signals and amplifies them to full logic levels using a clocked latching mechanism.

paper_reference.title: A Dual-Phase-Controlled Dynamic Latched Amplifier for High-Speed and Low-Power DRAMs

sensing_delay.description: Time from the enable signal (EN) assertion to the output nodes (N0, N1) developing a full logic level difference.

sky130_expected.calculation: Delay depends on the load capacitance and the transconductance of the cross-coupled inverters. For SKY130 at 1.8V, typical sensing delay is around 0.5ns to 2ns.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Scaled from 0.13um to 130nm (SKY130), performance should be similar or slightly slower due to 1.8V vs typical 1.2V/1.5V in 0.13um DRAM processes.

power_consumption.description: Average power consumption during a 200 MHz sensing cycle.

sky130_expected.calculation: Dynamic power P = C * V^2 * f. Assuming 50fF internal capacitance, P = 50e-15 * 1.8^2 * 200e6 = 32 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Dynamic amplifiers consume power primarily during switching. At 200MHz, power is expected to be in the tens of microwatts.

input_sensitivity.description: Minimum differential input voltage required for the amplifier to correctly resolve the data.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by threshold voltage mismatch and thermal noise. For typical 130nm devices, mismatch is around 10-20mV.
sky130_expected.reasoning: 100mV is a standard conservative margin for DRAM sense amplifiers to overcome mismatch and noise.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure sensing delay and power consumption of the dynamic latched amplifier at 200 MHz.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Dynamic Latched Amplifier
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 VDD VDD VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 VDD VDD IN VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 VDD VDD IN_B VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 VDD VDD N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 VDD VDD VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 VDD VDD N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 VDD VDD N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N0 EN N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 VDD VDD N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 VDD VDD VDD GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}

* Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
* 100mV differential input around 0.9V common-mode
VIN IN 0 0.95
VIN_B IN_B 0 0.85
* 200 MHz Enable Clock (5ns period)
VEN EN 0 PULSE(0 1.8 1n 0.1n 0.1n 2n 5n)

* Load capacitance
C1 N0 0 10f
C2 N1 0 10f

.control
tran 10p 10n

* Measure sensing delay from EN rising to N0 reaching 90% of VDD (1.62V)
meas tran sensing_delay trig v(EN) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(N0) val=1.62 rise=1

* Measure average power consumption over two 200MHz cycles (10ns)
meas tran avg_current avg i(VVDD) from=0 to=10n
let power_consumption = -avg_current * 1.8
print power_consumption

quit
.endc
.end
